name: Elemental Expertise
body:
Prerequisite(s): Elemental Focus, elemental attunement class feature or one Elemental Flux maneuver known.

Benefit(s): In addition to the normal energy types listed with Elemental Focus, you may select force, sonic, and untyped damage with the feat. The DC increase applies to any effect which either deals damage of the chosen type or is made as a result of an attack which deals damage of the chosen type (so Elemental Focus (fire) would increase the DC of plasma grenades).
